projects.title: Beat Commander
projects.blurb: One beat, every light in the room. A conductor sets the tempo, every board flashes on it, and booth controllers can take command. LoRa + ESP-NOW, no Wi-Fi.

projects.title: T-Scan
projects.blurb: Pocket Wi-Fi and BLE scanner. Passive: it only listens.

projects.title: W10 ISM Waterfall
projects.blurb: A live 902-928 MHz waterfall on the W10's own screen.

boards.title: W10 Conductor
boards.desc: Hears the kick through its mic, finds the tempo and the downbeat, and broadcasts every beat on LoRa.
boards.erases: Nothing: this firmware saves no settings.

boards.title: Beat Follower
boards.desc: Flashes in the conductor's colour on every beat, and keeps time on its own if a packet goes missing.
boards.erases: Nothing: this firmware saves no settings.

boards.title: Beat Bridge
boards.desc: Links the LoRa beat to the booth gear over ESP-NOW. Needs no screen, so a V3 with a dead OLED is perfect.
boards.erases: Nothing: this firmware saves no settings.

boards.title: Booth Console
boards.desc: Touchscreen BPM, beat flashes and link stats. TAKE grabs the beat from the W10 mid-set without a skip.
boards.erases: Display setting and touch calibration (you redo them on first boot).

boards.title: Beat Dial
boards.desc: Round handheld controller. Spin for tempo, press and spin to nudge, tap an enrolled tag or implant to take the beat.
boards.erases: Enrolled tags / implants and the lock setting.

boards.title: Pocket Conductor
boards.desc: The W10's beat engine on the StickS3's mic. Go ON AIR to lead the whole rig, or switch to FOLLOW and wear the beat.
boards.boot: Usually connects; if not, unplug and retry right after plugging in.

boards.title: Beat Command Center
boards.desc: The big booth screen: beat ring, huge BPM, tempo graph and touch pads to take the beat over. Plug the Beat Gateway into its USB-A port as its radio.
boards.boot: Hold reset about 2 s until the green LED blinks fast, then INSTALL.

boards.title: Beat Gateway
boards.desc: Hears the beat link and plugs into your laptop or Pi as a USB MIDI clock, or into the Tab5 as its radio. Add Beat Hub for Ableton Link, OSC and a live page.
boards.boot: Re-flashing: unplug, hold B (tiny button by the USB port), plug in, let go, INSTALL, pick "USB JTAG/serial debug unit". It can sit at 100% when done: unplug and replug.

boards.title: T-Scan
boards.desc: Wi-Fi and BLE scanner on the 1.14" screen. Lists what's around you; never transmits.
boards.boot: Hold the left front button, tap reset on the top edge, release.

boards.title: T-Scan
boards.desc: The scanner on the T-Embed's 1.9" screen, driven by the knob.
boards.boot: Hold the knob down while plugging in, release.

boards.title: T-Scan
boards.desc: The scanner shrunk onto a USB stick's 0.96" screen.
boards.boot: Hold BOOT while plugging in, release.

boards.title: ISM Waterfall
boards.desc: Watch LoRa, Meshtastic and LoRaWAN traffic scroll by across the US ISM band.
boards.erases: Nothing: this firmware saves no settings.
